title: INI loader: DEFAULT values memoised across sections and multi-line entries reporting their last line

hidden_checks.spec: Symptom 1 reproduction; rule 4: inherited [DEFAULT] values are interpolated in the context of the inheriting section.
Rule 4: for every section independently.
Rule 4 (chains of inherited values) + rule 3 lookup order.
Rule 4: including when it is reached through ${section:key}.
Rule 1: sections() excludes [DEFAULT]; cfg[section] has own keys followed by inherited keys.
Rule 3: $$ is a literal $; rule 1: keys case-insensitive.
Rule 3: section names are case-sensitive; rule 6: undefined reference at the entry's line.
Rule 3: ${section:key} section must exist; rule 6 lineno of the entry containing the reference.
Rule 5: resolution order and cycles raise ConfigError; rule 6: lineno = start of the entry containing the offending reference.
Rule 2: comment lines do not end a value, pieces joined with single spaces, inline comments need whitespace before #/;.
Rule 2: indented lines continue the previous entry's value, joined with single spaces.
Symptom 2 reproduction; rule 6: lineno is the first line of a multi-line value; str is 'line N: <message>'.
Rule 6: bad $ usage reported at the line where the entry starts.
Rule 6: unterminated reference at the entry's first line (comment lines inside the value skipped, rule 2).
Rule 6: duplicate keys reported at the line where the second one starts.
Rule 6: malformed lines and duplicate sections at their own line.
Rule 6: keys outside a section, empty keys, continuation lines with no preceding entry (that line).
Rule 6: cycles reported at the start line of the entry containing the offending reference.
Rule 6: getint on a non-integer reports the entry that defines the value (its first line).
Rule 6: the defining entry may be in [DEFAULT].
